title: Resources

list.typesFailed: Couldn't load resource types. Types are shown by id.

pick.title: Select a resource or create one
pick.body: Pick a resource in the list to see its content, settings, and where it's used.

unknownType: This server doesn't know the resource type ({type}). Check that the plugin is loaded.

content.noHtmlPreview: HTML isn't previewed (to prevent running scripts).
